summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by The Real Brokerage Inc. reporting voting results from its annual general meeting on May 29, 2026. Shareholders set the board at nine directors, elected all nine nominees (including Tamir Poleg, Vikki Bartholomae, etc.), and re-appointed Brightman Almagor Zohar as auditors. This is a routine meeting circular with no forced departure or abrupt management change. The category is Management Changes only if a departure is the event itself; here there is none, so this is a routine AGM report. The proper category is None.
